name: Reg Phillips
residence: Dubois area, Fremont County (he wrote that he had lived there 46 years and in Wyoming since 1976; 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
occupation: Retired ranch manager (41 years); commercial property management for a previous ranch owner (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
education: Degree in animal science, Kansas State University (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: In his 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, Reg Phillips wrote that he was born in Arizona, later spent about eight years in Kansas, where he finished a degree in animal science at Kansas State University, has been in Wyoming since 1976, and had lived in the Dubois area 46 years. He said he would be 73 on Election Day 2024, had been married 47 years, and that he and his wife raised three children in Dubois.

He wrote that the focus of his adult life had been cow-calf and yearling operations, that he was retired from the ranch where he was the manager for 41 years, and that he was doing commercial property management for a previous ranch owner. He also wrote that he had served as a board member for local conservation and rural fire districts and had participated in the Shoshone Forest Plan Revision, the Fremont County Natural Resource Plan Revision, Fremont County’s Wyoming Public Lands Initiative, and Governor Mead’s Task Force on Forests.
